summary: Reviewed every changed product path. The defect is a contract opt-in mismatch: legacy free-form dependencies and verification evidence were constrained by new schema/runtime checks. Both now use execution_contract presence, including rejecting malformed explicit contracts. Dependency traversal stops at legacy nodes while the incoming done/release receipt check remains. Explicit intake remains strict; adoption errors identify task metadata before any writes. Original strict JSON subschemas are byte-equivalent as parsed objects after relocation. 33 synthetic regressions cover six legacy shapes in four states, explicit contracts, graph boundary, adoption atomicity/history and v0.3.7 pin update/rollback. 88 focused tests passed on macOS and Linux; candidate distribution and make checks passed. Private snapshot: 156 tasks, old runtime valid, v0.3.26 reports 33 errors, repaired runtime valid, all task hashes unchanged. No private task content published; live consumer untouched. Final tag and release readback remain downstream gates.
